# BAD-050 — Pin or unify the admin's two unpinned parseVersion regex copies in lib/actions.ts

## Brief
admin/src/lib/actions.ts carries two hand-written copies of parseVersion's strictness, FLAG_VERSION_RE (line 50) and VERSION_RE (line 433), and no test pins either against _shared/clientversion.mjs, unlike VERSION_MATCH in lib/accounts.ts, which test/server/admin-version-key.test.mjs pins. BAD-036 Phase 2 moves them into two different files (actions/flags.ts and actions/announcements.ts), which makes the duplicate harder to see. The refactor must not merge them, because that is a rule change, not a move.

Evidence: actions.ts:48-50 FLAG_VERSION_RE = /^v?\d+(\.\d+){0,2}$/ ('The same strictness as parseVersion'); actions.ts:433 VERSION_RE = /^v?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){0,2}$/; saveAnnouncement's message at 487 says 'readable by parseVersion'; admin-version-key.test.mjs reads only lib/accounts.ts.
